Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1983
AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the
Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part. 1, 3rd November, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.--The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :---
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Agricultural .Development Bank (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Agricultural Development Bank First Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 10, Ordinance IV of 1961

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1983
ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1983
AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT BANK (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the
Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part. 1, 3rd November, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.--The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :---
2. Amendment of section 10, Ordinance IV of 1961.--In the
Agricultural Development Bank Ordinance, 1961 (IV of 1961), in section 10,
after subsection (1), the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely :-
"(1.A) The
Chairman shall on the expiry of his term of office be eligible for
reappointment."
